expect_red: a set of holes fits as a pattern -- count, size, axis and the circle the centres are on -- and says it in one line; a set that is no pattern is null (feature_geometry.hole_pattern)

mutations.contract: Every hole of a pattern is like the first: two sizes are no pattern.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_pattern_is_bound_as_its_like_faces_and_a_face_can_be_added (2026-11-15). Drops the check, so a set of two sizes fits as a pattern of the first size.

mutations.contract: The hole radius is the faces' mean, not the first face's.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_pattern_is_bound_as_its_like_faces_and_a_face_can_be_added (2026-11-15). Reads the first face's radius.
mutations.find: var radius = records.reduce(function (s, r) { return s + r.radius; }, 0) / records.length;

mutations.contract: On a circle only when every centre is on it.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_pattern_is_bound_as_its_like_faces_and_a_face_can_be_added (2026-11-15). Drops the residual test: any fitted circle is reported.
mutations.find: if (residual > tol.circleFraction * fit.r || fit.r > tol.circleMaxSpread * spread) return out;

mutations.contract: Every hole of a fitted pattern is whole: two half holes are no pattern.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_pattern_is_bound_as_its_like_faces_and_a_face_can_be_added (2026-11-15), after the review agent's pre-review note. Drops the check, so the fixture's two half holes (faces 0 and 2) fit as '2 holes'.
